title: Simple Variable Mass 6DOF Wind (Quaternion)
text: Implement quaternion representation of six-degrees-of-freedom equations of motion of simple variable mass with respect to wind axes, 4 inputs, 12 outputs, {Mass type} sets Mass type Simple; {Units} sets the input and output units Metric, {Representation} sets the equations of motion representation, {Initial position in inertial axes [Xe,Ye,Ze]} sets the position in inertial axes, {Initial airspeed, angle of attack, and sideslip angle [V,alpha,beta]} sets the initial airspeed, angle of attack, and sideslip angle, {Initial wind orientation [bank angle,flight path angle,heading angle]} sets the initial wind orientation, {Initial body rotation rates [p,q,r]} sets the initial body rotation, {Initial mass}, {Empty mass}, {Full mass}, {Inertia in body axis} sets the inertia of body eye, {Empty inertia matrix in body axis} sets the inertia tensor matrix for empty inertia, {Full inertia matrix in body axis} sets the inertia tensor matrix for full inertia, {Include mass flow relative velocity} sets the mass flow relative velocity port, {Include inertial acceleration}, {Position: e.g., ’Xe’,’Ye’,’Ze’} sets the position state name, {Velocity: e.g., ’V’} sets the velocity state name, {Incidence angle e.g., ’alpha’} sets the incidence angle state name, {Sideslip angle e.g., ’beta’} sets the sideslip angle state name, {Wind orientation e.g., ’mu’, ’gamma’, ’chi’} sets the wind orientation state names, {Quaternion vector: e.g., ’qr’,’qi’,’qj’,’qk’} sets the quaternion vector state name, {Body rotation rates: e.g., ’p’,’q’,’r’} sets the body rotation state names and {Mass: e.g., ’mass’} sets the mass state name. Values come from the instance.
